description: "GATHERING JEWELS" by James Knowles and Matilda Darroch Knowles is a memorial work that appears to have been written in the late 19th century. This collection reflects on the lives of James and Matilda Knowles, offering selected memoirs derived from their diaries, highlighting their commitment to Christian ideals and community service.
